description: ClustalW 2.1's sequence-to-profile alignment (clustalw -PROFILE1=a -PROFILE2=b -SEQUENCES, Clustal::sequencesAlignToProfile / MSA::seqsAlignToProfile), ported step by step and verified row-for-row against the installed clustalw 2.1 on 600 DNA and protein sets: the sequences are added to the existing alignment one at a time, the one with the highest identity to the aligned set first. Distances: the identities inside the profile (countid), the full (distance='clustalw') or fast k-tuple (distance='clustalw-quick', ktuple / window / topDiagonals / pairGap) pairwise stage between every other pair of rows (computed on the rows with their gaps; pwGapOpen / pwGapExtend / pwMatrix), then the neighbour-joining tree of all rows (or UPGMA) weights them; each sequence is aligned with weights = tree weight x identity to it and Myers-Miller profile alignment with position-specific gap penalties. Other parameters as multiple_align_clustalw. Rows are returned: profile, then sequences, in input order.

profile.description: Rows of the existing alignment (at least one; letters and '-').

sequences.description: The sequences to add (at least one; gaps '-' are kept as in the program).

ktuple.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: k-tuple (word) size, 1-4 for DNA (clustalw -KTUPLE, default 2), 1-2 for protein (default 1).

window.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: diagonals scanned around each top diagonal (clustalw -WINDOW, default 4 for DNA, 5 for protein).

topDiagonals.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: number of best diagonals used (clustalw -TOPDIAGS, default 4 for DNA, 5 for protein).

pairGap.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: gap penalty of the fragment chain (clustalw -PAIRGAP; DNA default 5, or ktuple + 4 when ktuple is given; protein default 3, or ktuple + 3, as the clustalw command line does).

variableRegionGaps.description: type='protein': ClustalW -NOVGAP (sic: switches the variable-region penalties ON).

clustering.description: ClustalW -CLUSTERING of the guide tree: 'nj' (default) or 'upgma'.

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA (input order).

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a nucleotide beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Natural affine sum-of-pairs score of the alignment under match / mismatch / scoreGapOpen / scoreGapExtend (ClustalW itself reports no such score).

errors.message: Both inputs must contain at least one sequence
Invalid DNA (type=dna) or protein (type=protein) residue in a row; letters and '-' only
type must be dna or protein; distance must be clustalw or clustalw-quick; clustering must be nj or upgma; matrix / pwMatrix must be gonnet, blosum, pam or id
